title: Society Wives — Author-Locked Source Vault
policy: The archive is an immutable historical baseline. Never edit or overwrite the four archived source files. Future author-approved changes must be saved as separately versioned files and linked as a new edition. Snapshot approval preserves the original document content and does not silently contradict editorial labels written INSIDE the originals. UI display is source reading, distinct from final episode reader publication.

verification.method: For each of three native Google Docs, joined source paragraph text by LF without rewriting and compared it exactly with both committed .txt and the committed .json paragraphs. Existing Taniya EP04B JSON compared whole text with frozen copy. Every match returned true.
verification.formatLimit: Google Docs visual page layout, image objects and typography are not represented by the plain-text snapshots. Each document's paragraph text and original order are preserved; paragraph style labels are retained in JSON.

handoff: Start new chats by opening this manifest and relevant individual source snapshot. Never infer the full source from a link or summary. If the author changes a locked baseline, create a new version with explicit approval and retain the old snapshot for history.
